projectDescription: SafeSide Prevention provides suicide prevention education, consultation, and evaluation programs for healthcare, government, military, schools, and community organizations.
keyFeatures: SafeSide CARE — person-centered suicide prevention workforce education via InPlace® Learning
Core Connections — evidence-based team cohesion and resilience program for military and first responders
CAMS Treatment — collaborative, evidence-based suicide-specific therapy training for clinicians
SafeSide Restore — restorative just culture framework for post-incident organizational learning
InPlace® Learning model — blended video-guided workshops with ongoing live sessions and refreshers
Program add-ons — self-paced modules on safety planning, C-SSRS, risk formulation, and means safety
Customization — three levels of content adaptation for sector, culture, and organizational context
Evaluation and impact measurement — standardized pre/post evaluations with self-efficacy and learning transfer metrics
CME credits — 3 AMA Category 1 CME credits available through University of Rochester
Sector-specific adaptations — Mental Health, Primary Health, Youth Services, Alcohol & Other Drugs, Military, Schools
publicApiSurface: SafeSide Live Learning Sessions (monthly Q&A and expert-led deep dives)
SafeSide Account (host portal for accessing guides, resources, and toolkits)
Post-workshop evaluation (online assessment linked from participant workbook)
Program add-on self-paced modules (30–60 min eLearning completions)
CAMS Foundational Video Course (10 hours online + consultation calls)
SafeSide Restore Network (bi-monthly leader network meetings)
SafeSide Framework (C.A.R.E. — Connect, Assess, Respond, Extend)
